positive_queries.query:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  url:  <http://schema.org/>

SELECT  ?var1 ?var2 ?var3 ?var4 ?var5
WHERE
  { ?var1 wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)* wde:Q11424
    OPTIONAL
      { BIND(lang(?var2) AS ?var3)
        ?var1  rdfs:label   ?var2 ;
               wdt:Q783521  ?var4
        FILTER ( ( lang(?var2) = "es" ) && ( strlen(?var4) > 0 ) )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var5  url:about       ?var1 ;
               url:inLanguage  "es"
        FILTER ( substr(str(?var5), 1, 25) = "string1" )
      }
  }
